Racing Zip Jacket & Sunglasses
Rights check

Sporty, sharp, Y2K
WORKING NOTES

details.
- Keep the graphics generic to avoid text in the image.
Try this: Keep the racing graphics generic, without readable

IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
windswept brown hair wears
wraparound black sunglasses and a
black and gray racing-style zip jacket
with a funnel neck, contrast side panels,
and embroidered racing graphics. A
black shoulder bag hangs from one
shoulder, and black cargo trousers with
a belt complete the look. Her expression
is calm and confident. A plain white
backdrop with soft, even light. Palette of
black, charcoal, and silver. Sporty and
sharp, in the style of a Y2K activewear
lookbook.
